Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:92684

Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 18053 of 2025

Applicant :- Rahul Patel
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Rajkumar Verma
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.
2.

The instant application has been preferred with the prayer to quash the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial No. 56 of 2019, titled State v. Rahul Patel, arising out of Case Crime No. 129 of 2018,
under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) 120B IPC read with Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Shivpur,
District Varanasi, pending in the Court of Additional Session Judge Court No. 7/Special Judge,
POCSO Act.

entities.text:
Additional Session Judge Court No. 7/Special Judge,
POCSO Act.
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. This Court, vide order dated 20.05.2025, had directed the Station House Officer, PS Shivpur,
District Varanasi to verify that the facts stated by the applicant by recording the statement of the victim and submit a report in this regard.
4. Today, learned AGA has produced the verification report in Court, which is taken on record.

sentences.text: On the basis of the verification report, it is stated by learned AGA that the victim and applicant are living together at Ahmedabad along with his family members and they have been blessed with two children.
The complainant (the mother of the victim) has already died.
In this regard, death certificate issued by the Department of Medical and Health, Nagar Nigam, Varanasi, Government of Uttar Pradesh, dated 20.03.2025 is filed along with verification report.

entities.text: Department of Medical and Health, Nagar Nigam
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Birth certificates of the children issued by the District Mahila Hospital, Jaunpur and Department of Medical and Health,
are also filed on record.

entities.text:
Department of Medical and Health,
are
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. In the above factual backdrop, allowing the criminal proceedings to continue would amount to unnecessary harassment and wastage of judicial time.

Therefore, in the interest of justice, this Court finds it a fit case for exercising its inherent jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
7.

Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Sessions Trial No. 56 of 2019, titled State v. Rahul Patel,
arising out of Case Crime No. 129 of 2018, under Sections 363, 366, 376(3) 120B IPC read with Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Shivpur, District Varanasi, pending in the Court of Additional Session Judge Court No. 7/Special Judge, POCSO Act, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: Court of Additional Session Judge Court No. 7/Special Judge, POCSO Act,
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 8. The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. stands allowed.
